history.speaker: nessa
history.text: There's a spare in the office. We finally made a list.

history.speaker: narrator
history.text: You lock the house behind you. In the tower, the old paper stays blank. On the harbor board, the ferry time is an estimate with a named source. In your bag, the catalogue has room for corrections. You have learned something about the future, but it is smaller and more useful than the thing you thought you came to learn.

history.speaker: ada
history.text: It doesn't have to tell me what to do.

history.speaker: narrator
history.text: The island offers no answer. It has people for that now. You walk down toward them, carrying the record of what happened and leaving enough empty paper for what happens next.
